title: Graph-normalized sum-to-compact-support map of strict varying-ring systems
statement: Fix a universe $u$, rings $C_n$ of universe $u+1$ and ring homomorphisms $\tau_n:C_{n+1}\to C_n$. Use the constant-ring strict semilinear system categories and ordinary unbounded derived operations of [def-sp-semilinear-constant-ring-operations]. For a separated etale, locally finite-type quasi-compact map $e:U\to T$ [def-weil-etale-morphism] [def-weil-proper-morphism] and compactification $c=(i,g)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], define the localized sum extension $e_{\Sigma!}$ as the left adjoint of restriction to the localization, retaining its sheafification adjunction. Identify localization restriction with geometric inverse image by the unique comparison preserving its section-restriction adjunction. Thus the sum adjunction has the fixed summand inclusion unit and fibre-sum counit. All adjunction comparisons use [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. For each pro-etale lift $W\to U$, form its graph inside the pullback of the compactification; it is clopen. Define the ordinary map $\gamma:e_{\Sigma!}\to g_*i_!$ by its unique section characterization: the image of a lift summand is the open-extension unit on that graph and zero on its complement, where $i_!$ is [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf]. Define $\theta:De_{\Sigma!}\to Rg_*Di_!$ as the unique derived natural transformation whose value on every homotopy representative is the degreewise map $\gamma$, the canonical homotopy composition comparison, and the total right-derived direct-image unit. These are the already defined normalized maps, not an arbitrary natural isomorphism or a choice of finite evaluations. This node records the definitions only; their exactness, existence/uniqueness and finite evaluation properties are theorem statements in lem-sp-varying-ring-graph-summand.
